prompt:
Create a high-fidelity OmniGear 'Perfis' mouse configuration UI comparison. Inherit the attached approved interface's exact chrome, sidebar, monochrome typography, spacing and button styling. Reference is VISUAL IDENTITY ONLY: replace all DPI content with profile management. Square board: TWO complete desktop landscape viewports stacked vertically, DARK above and LIGHT below, equal size and same content. Crisp readable Brazilian Portuguese; no exterior captions or browser frame.
Header 'OmniGear' + small 'Demonstração' badge; ONE moon outline icon right in dark, ONE sun outline icon right in light. No theme switch or paired icons. Sidebar20% width: '← Dispositivos', 'Mouse de demonstração', 'Perfil 1' dropdown; nav 'Botões','DPI','Desempenho','Parâmetros','Perfis' SELECTED,'Geral'.
Main heading 'Perfis', subtitle 'Organize e salve suas configurações.' Top right outlined 'Importar' and 'Exportar' buttons with subtle upload/download icons. Scope is local/device profiles, NOT cloud: no account, login, cloud column or sharing. Four demo onboard slots only: Slot1 'Perfil 1' marked 'Em uso'; Slot2 'FPS'; Slot3 'Trabalho'; Slot4 'Slot vazio'. Active slot1 is also selected for editing; no confusion between selected and active. Slot1 summary '800 DPI · 1000 Hz'. Slot2 summary '400 DPI · 1000 Hz'. Slot3 summary '1600 DPI · 500 Hz'. These are demonstration data, already clearly indicated by header badge. Occupied profiles can be renamed and loaded. Slot4 has 'Gravar aqui' action to save current settings into empty slot, not unlimited New profile. Keep count '3 de 4 slots ocupados' secondary.
Important dirty state: main bottom footer left '1 alteração não salva', right secondary 'Descartar' primary 'Salvar no perfil 1' (white on dark, black on light). A small note above footer 'As alterações atuais ainda não foram gravadas no Perfil 1.' Do not claim save completed when dirty. Do not add deletion controls, timestamps, file sizes, synchronization or duplicate new profile creation. All content must fit above footer. Clear everyday utility interface, thin dividers, neutral contrast.
OPTION2: One broad table spanning main body with columns 'Slot','Perfil','Configuração','Ação'. Four generous horizontal rows, thin separators. Active row1 subtle neutral fill: slot1, inline editable name field 'Perfil 1' plus Em uso badge, configuration800DPI /1000Hz, action text 'Em uso' or check. Row2 slot2 FPS with small pencil rename icon,400DPI/1000Hz, 'Carregar'. Row3 slot3 Trabalho with pencil rename icon,1600DPI/500Hz,Carregar. Row4 slot4 Slot vazio, em dash in configuration, 'Gravar aqui'. Under table '3 de 4 slots ocupados', generous breathing room and dirty note before common footer. No sidebar inspector or cards. Import/export in heading remain clear.
title: Tabela de perfis
description: Nomes, configurações e ações alinhados em uma lista compacta.
notes: Profile count and values are demo examples; actual slot count comes from capabilities. Loading with dirty draft needs confirmation. Import must validate compatibility before replacing settings. Export selected profile with explicit handling of unsaved draft. Rename/import/export are proposed design interactions, not claims of implemented functionality.
